subject: Recap & ask: NovaFarm monthly token band + procurement path
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novafarm.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: usage profile + procurement thresholds

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick written recap from our call and two asks so we can land next steps with Procurement: 

Call highlights (as I captured them) —
- Primary workload: real-time product recommendations (text + short prompts) integrated in web app; avg seq len ~80 tokens, occasional long tails to ~400.
- Expected cadence: steady-state ~120M tokens/month, with seasonal spikes up to ~200M for campaign windows.
- Latency SLO: 200–300ms p95; tolerance for batch windows for non-critical backfill.
- Data controls: customer data must remain isolated; SOC2 evidence required for legal.

Initial commercial guidance — (ballpark unit econ we discussed)
- Band A (pilot): 10–25M tokens / month — list price: $10 / 1M tokens (recommended pilot pricing)
- Band B (growth): 25–150M tokens / month — blended price: $7.5 / 1M tokens (volume bands + caching)
- Band C (enterprise): 150M+ tokens / month — target price: $6 / 1M tokens (commit + reserved capacity)

Procurement thresholds we discussed
- PO required for recurring spend > $20k/month (finance constraint you mentioned)
- If deal requires vendor security review, expect 2–3 week legal lead time for SOC2 & contract redlines

Asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm which monthly band you want to validate for procurement (Pilot / Growth / Enterprise)? That will let me send the right pricing and internal approvals.
2) Please introduce your procurement contact (email) and let me know if NovaFarm requires a PO template or a specific payment cadence.

I attached a short consumption model (consumption_model.xlsx) and a one-page proposal draft (nova_proposal_v1.pdf) with the same banding + worked examples. If helpful I can prepare a 30-day pilot quote with a capped spend.

Thanks — will follow up with a legal/compliance checklist if you confirm the band.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@novafarm.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novafarm.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: usage profile + procurement thresholds

Hi Logan —

Appreciate the clear summary, this matches what we captured internally. A few clarifying Qs from Procurement and Finance before we loop in Legal: 

1) Can you confirm the $/1M token rate you quoted for Band B (25–150M)? We need the exact per-1M number and any step-down bands inside that range.
2) Is there an overage mechanism (e.g., charge at list vs. step-down) if we spike above the committed band for a month?
3) Finance flagged that any recurring vendor spend above $50k/mo needs SVP approval — curious whether Redwood has experience with PO + monthly invoice cadence vs prepay.
4) For SOC2 evidence, do you have an attestation and a point of contact for security questions?

Procurement contact for introduction: procurement@novafarm.com (cc’d). Our procurement lead is Marissa Cole (marissa@novafarm.com) — she handles PO templates.

We'd like a conservative pilot quote in the first pass (25–40M tokens/month) so we can board the product in Q3 — can you confirm a pilot cap option?

Thanks,
Elena
Director, Product 
NovaFarm

Subject: Re: Recap: usage profile + procurement thresholds — clarified pricing and pilot cap

Elena / Marissa —

Thanks — answered inline and attached a tightened pilot quote. Key points below: 

Pricing detail (Band B clarity) —
- 0–25M: $10 / 1M tokens (pilot list)
- 25–100M: $8 / 1M tokens
- 100–150M: $7 / 1M tokens
- >150M: negotiate enterprise reserved pricing (typical target $6 / 1M)

Overage behavior —
- Temporary spikes above committed band will be billed at the next tier up (e.g., a month at 110M while committed to 100M will be billed at the 100–150M tier for that month); we provide a single consolidated invoice monthly.
- For customers who want hard caps we can set hard limit alerts and an enforcement rule (requests rejected past the cap) for pilot periods.

Payment cadence & approvals —
- We support monthly invoicing on net-30 with PO. Prepay/credit alternatives available for pilot if you prefer to avoid PO lead times.
- Per your note, SVP approval for recurring > $50k/mo is expected; if you confirm target band I can include a finance note for executive approvers.

Security & compliance —
- We have a current SOC2 Type II report (attachments: SOC2 snapshot available on request). Security lead: Karthik Iyer (karthik@redwood.inference.com) — happy to run a short call with your security/infosec team.

Pilot cap suggestion —
- Recommended conservative pilot: 25–40M tokens / month for 30 days. Estimated cost (no commitment): 25M x $8 = $200 — 40M x $8 = $320 (we can cap at $400 to give you breathing room).

Next steps I propose: 
1) Marissa — can you share NovaFarm PO template and preferred invoice recipient?
2) Elena — confirm whether you want the hard-cap pilot or soft spike billing.
3) If Procurement needs a PO + monthly invoice workflow, we'll route pricing and SLA to Legal for a 2-week review.

I attached an updated consumption_model.xlsx with a worked example for the 25–40M pilot and a one-page pilot quote in nova_proposal_v1.pdf (marked updated).

Happy to hop on a 15-min call with Marissa and your Finance lead if helpful — I can do 11:00–12:00 PT Thursday.

Best,
Logan Wright
